## Published Work

### Uses and Gratifications Sought From Mobile Phones and Loneliness Among Japanese Midlife and Older Adults
*Innovation in Aging, 2020*

Mediation analysis examining how mobile phone use patterns relate to loneliness outcomes in a nationally representative Japanese sample.

- **Methods:** Mediation analysis, regression modeling
- **Tools:** Stata
- **[View Code on GitHub](https://github.com/honoluluhan717/Japan-loneliness-study)**

## Ongoing Projects

### WTC First Responders Frailty Study
Longitudinal study of frailty prevalence, predictors, risk factors, and health outcomes in World Trade Center first responders. Lead biostatistician — responsible for statistical analysis plan, all Stata pipelines, and results interpretation.

- **Methods:** Mixed effects models, survival analysis, causal inference, longitudinal regression
- **Tools:** Stata
- **Status:** 🟡 Ongoing — manuscript in preparation
- **[View Full Project Page](wtc-frailty.qmd)**

### ADRD Drug Repurposing Study
Using large-scale CMS Medicare & Medicaid claims data to identify candidate drugs for Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) repurposing. Lead analyst applying causal inference methods to observational claims data.

- **Methods:** Causal inference, pharmacoepidemiology, claims data analysis
- **Tools:** Stata, SQL
- **[View Full Project Page](adrd-repurposing.qmd)**

### Palliative Care at Home RCT
Randomized controlled trial evaluating a home-based palliative care intervention. Responsible for research database management, CONSORT diagram design, and statistical analysis planning.

- **Methods:** RCT design, CONSORT reporting, longitudinal outcomes
- **Tools:** Stata, R
- **Status:** 🟡 Recruitment ongoing
